description: Live City of Los Angeles Department of Building & Safety permit records across building, electrical and mechanical trades (issued or submitted), Certificates of Occupancy, and legacy detailed permits. Fields include permit identity/type/status, submitted/issue/status/CoO dates, address and zoning, council district, APN/PIN, community plan area, neighbourhood council, use code/description, valuation, square footage, construction type, height, ADU/EV/solar flags, geolocation, and contractor/applicant/occupancy details where LADBS publishes them.

permits.description: Dataset containing all scraped LA permit records.
